# A literal outer phase sweep generated by the actual layer header

Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance.
Apache-2.0. This is a scoped constructive proof with finite corroboration;
independent human and proof-kernel acceptance are not claimed. No new kappa.

## 1. Exact source, novelty and full-cost gate

Canonical base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`.
`upstream/build/sections/05-layers.tex`, the `phase-butterfly-layer` identity
and `simultaneous-layer` proposition, require

\[
H_0^{\otimes D}=b^D\mathcal S_D C^{\otimes D}\mathcal S_D,
\qquad b=(1-i)/2,
\qquad (\mathcal S_Dz)(x)=i^{x_1+\cdots+x_D}z(x).
\]

The address set is `[P] x [2^K]^D x [S]` in lexicographic order, with r
Gaussian coefficients at each address. Each x_j is bit rho of its K-bit
chunk, numbered from the least significant end. The actual header is

\[
\Gamma(p)\Gamma(d)\Gamma(r)\Gamma(D)\Gamma(P)\Gamma(S)
\Gamma(K)\Gamma(\rho+1)\Gamma(w).
\]

Canonical `02-streams.tex` defines Gamma(v) as `0^(bit_length(v)-1) bin(v)`
for positive v. Both exact sources are included with authenticated pins.

Ali Romman's [#5375](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5375)
already supplies a sequential finite-symbol monomial phase producer, a
binary-counter amortization proof and a Gaussian consumer. Its recipe size
m is fixed; its active-position mask is supplied; its demonstrated consumer
has one coefficient per record and separate consumed-input/output owners.
It explicitly leaves mask manufacture, packed repetition, mixed-width
interfaces and literal transition-table lowering open. Its phase identity,
Gaussian arithmetic and odometer argument are credited, not rediscovered.

The preceding [literal egress package](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/51ab0539059214fcfa044938c36a0b6017232be5/research/literal-layer-egress)
supplies the b^D normalizer and one final toward-zero projection, while both
S_D sweeps remain supplied. The current contribution supplies those sweeps
at their actual common-width boundary. It generates the mask from the header,
handles variable D on a fixed tape inventory, implements all P/S/r
repetition, and installs exact integer Gaussian rotations on the same owner.
Its literal Gamma, trace, staging and cleanup patterns credit that package.

Put L=DK, Q=2^L, M=PQS, N=Mr, V=2Nw and E=header length. The optimistic
complete budget passed before construction: unary r,P,S acquisition costs
O(r+P+S)<=O(N); mask construction costs O(L); an incrementally maintained
phase costs O(PQ+L), including carry returns; coefficient work and installation
cost O(Nw). Thus no source-band amortization of an extra per-record DK factor
is needed. The theorem below proves the literal bound and retains all histories.

## 2. Literal theorem and admitted windows

Assume positive p,d,r,D,P,S,K,w, with D<=d, 0<=rho<K and w>=p+2. The program
receives the nine Gamma words on HEADER and exactly N Gaussian pairs on DATA,
real before imaginary, each component a signed w-bit two's-complement integer
written MSB first. DATA has a blank at offset V. Header exterior after its
ninth word may contain arbitrary symbols; the program does not scan it.

Twenty physical tapes are distinct. Eighteen private tapes have blank owned
guards at offset -1 and blank bodies wherever this call visits. All heads
start at their supplied, arbitrarily translated origins. Opaque exterior
outside these windows is preserved. Whole-window blankness is a supplied
ownership premise, not established by reading only the origin. Entry histories
and exterior backing remain charged; no object reset grants fresh memory.

One fixed table with **2,146 instruction locations**, four symbols
`{blank,0,1,|}`, twenty tapes and no input parameters performs the sweep. Its
only instructions are scanned-symbol branch, one-cell write, unit move,
fixed goto and halt. Python generates the finite graph; no decoded header
value, address, variable-width recipe or payload integer enters runtime control.
Undefined local-symbol branches reject; a designated empty branch is the
explicit range/header-domain sink. A simultaneous multitape transition table
can expand every local read over other tapes' four symbols, a fixed expansion.

If all required rotated components fit w signed bits, the table replaces DATA
on its original owner by S_D DATA, preserves HEADER and every exterior symbol,
restores every head and erases every private body and owned guard. Otherwise,
numerical range rejection occurs before the first DATA write, preserving the
entire public input. No head return, cleanup or restart after rejection is
promised. Malformed headers, false ownership premises and resource-fault
recovery are outside the successful theorem; finite invalid-input controls
do not extend that theorem silently.

Unlike a supplied-length phase iterator, this program derives its complete
cardinality from the header. It rejects a missing payload bit and checks for
the blank end immediately after the last required component, before commit.
No N, V, M or precomputed phase stream is supplied to execution.

## 3. Header interpretation and generated geometry

The unary Gamma decoder maintains the value of the consumed binary prefix.
The initial one writes unary 1; a following t replaces v by 2v+t using
DOUBLE, erases the old value, and restores both heads. LENGTH stores the
number of Gamma tail digits still to consume. HTRACE records exactly one
marker per HEADER move. Returning along it erases the trace and restores
HEADER without knowing E or reading exterior.

All nine parameters are decoded, including r,P,S. Expanding these three
values is legitimate here because each is at most N; a huge header value
is accompanied by the correspondingly huge complete admitted payload.
The theorem does not claim constant work in their encoded lengths alone.
Unary parallel scans check D<=d and w>=p+2.

For each of the D chunks, scan K unary symbols. Advance SELECT, whose length
is rho+1, until its next scanned symbol is blank. Write a one to MASK at that
position and zeroes elsewhere in the chunk. The before/after finite state
ensures there is exactly one active position. If K ends before the active
position, reject. At the chunk boundary rewind both K and SELECT; advance D.
In parallel write a zero to COUNT at every mask cell.

Consequently both bodies have length L=DK, COUNT is zero and

\[
\operatorname{MASK}[j]=1\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad j\bmod K=\rho.
\]

These bodies are LSB first. The first K positions describe the last address
chunk, the next K the preceding one, and so forth. This matches lexicographic
enumeration of the D chunks. Since the selected phase is the sum over chunks,
the identical mask recipe needs no stored chunk identifier. All initial
geometry parameters except the repetition and width tapes are now erased.

## 4. Complete enumeration and four-state phase invariant

At a counter value u, maintain in finite control

\[
q=\sum_{j=0}^{L-1}\operatorname{MASK}[j]\operatorname{COUNT}[j]\pmod4.
\]

It starts at zero. Increment the complete binary counter from its LSB.
Flipping old bit b at an active mask position changes q by 1-2b; an inactive
flip changes nothing. Each update is a fixed transition among four states.
A zero-to-one flip ends the carry; return both heads over the changed prefix.
A one-to-zero flip advances to the next bit. Reaching the blank after L
symbols means all bits wrapped to zero. Rewind both heads; q is again zero.

This proves the phase invariant by each individual bit flip. Standard binary
induction proves exact enumeration 0,...,Q-1, with no skipped or duplicated
chunk addresses. Every chunk address is retained for S spectator records and
r coefficients per record, using unary head positions as loop counters. An
r-boundary rewinds that counter; an S-boundary rewinds S and advances COUNT.
A complete Q-wrap advances P. At P's end the stream has consumed exactly
P Q S r=N pairs. No loop index or decoded parameter lives in host control.

The complete-domain bit-flip count, including final wrap, is 2Q-2: bit j
changes Q/2^j times, and summing j=0,...,L-1 gives that geometric sum.
Every return traverses only the just-changed prefix. There is no per-record
full-L rewind or hidden scan of historical capacity. The complete counter
bill for P repetitions is therefore O(PQ), even when D and K vary.

## 5. Signed coefficient action, staging and original-owner return

Load w bits each into REAL and IMAG, logging every DATA move in DTRACE.
WIDTH is a unary ruler; each load restores it. The four phase cases are

| q | Returned real | Returned imaginary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | a | c |
| 1 | -c | a |
| 2 | -a | -c |
| 3 | c | -a |

For a required negation, seek the component's LSB, complement and add one
while walking backward. Its carry is one bit. Retain the last old and new
bits in finite control. At the left marker these are the original and new
sign bits. Both are one exactly for the unrepresentable negation of
-2^(w-1); reject then. Otherwise this is exact integer negation, including
zero. Thus the guard is necessary and sufficient for every required output
component, rather than merely a modular-encoding check.

Append both resulting components to OUTPUT in MSB order and correct
real/imaginary order, erasing REAL and IMAG as consumed. Their heads return
over their erased bodies. All results are staged until every required pair
and the header-derived payload-end check have passed. Therefore an overflow
late in the stream preserves every public input bit, including earlier pairs.

DTRACE then returns DATA and erases itself. OUTPUT is rewound. Its V bits
are copied to the original DATA owner while OUTPUT is erased, with every
DATA move written again to DTRACE. Both fields have the same width and
length; no owner swap, free copying or uncharged size change occurs. Return
DATA using DTRACE and OUTPUT over its erased body. Erase the retained unary
parameters, MASK, COUNT and all eighteen private guards. This proves complete
successful retirement and exact head restoration.

## 6. Universal complete instruction bound

Each read, write, move and goto costs one literal instruction. A marker is
written and erased by ordinary instructions. The fixed table's generation
cost F is separate and independent of all parameters. It is not an input-sized
source-access oracle.

The basic exact loop allowances are: rewind a length-t prefix in 3t+3;
clear it in 7t+4; return a public head using a length-t trace in 5t+3.
One unary prefix update v->2v+b uses at most 47v+35 helper instructions
plus a constant Gamma-wrapper cost. Previous prefix values sum to less than
the final value and the number of digits is at most that value. This proves
linear cost in the decoded values and E, including DOUBLE/LENGTH retirement.

Geometry generation and its initial returns cost at most 64(L+1): each
chunk's K and SELECT scans/returns cost O(K), since rho+1<=K. There are
D chunks. Comparisons and parameter retirement are linear in the unary
values. In particular, r+P+S<=3N, D,K,rho+1<=L. A sufficient combined
allowance for every header, geometry, marker, comparison and parameter
initialization/retirement operation is

\[
4096(E+p+d+L+N+w+1).
\]

One component load costs at most 15w+7. One negation, including its LSB
search, costs at most 7w+5. One staging/erasing/return pass costs at most
9w+4. Even a pair needing both negations costs at most 62w+32 before its
constant repetition control. The complete r and S rewinds add O(N), since
the total lengths traversed over all record boundaries are N and M.

One counter increment changing t bits costs at most 12t+10, including both
returns and the complete-wrap handling. Across P domains this is less than
34PQ. Since PQ<=M<=N, a sufficient combined allowance for all coefficient
work, repetition and odometer work is

\[
512N(w+1).
\]

The two DATA returns, two OUTPUT rewinds and paid original-owner copy cost
24V+13, bounded by 32V+32. Final private parameter cleanup is already in the
metadata allowance. Using V=2Nw, N>=2, w>=3 and N+w<=Nw gives the claimed
conservative complete bound

\[
\boxed{T\le65536(E+p+d+DK+Nw+1).}
\]

A numerical range rejection executes a prefix of this bounded pass, so obeys
the same bound for a complete legal-width packet. Finite malformed-input
tests demonstrate their particular detection behavior; no general
resource-recovery theorem is inferred.

In the source family, E=O(p), d=Theta(p^epsilon) with epsilon<1, and w>=p+2.
Moreover DK<=2^(DK)<=M<=N. Hence T=O(Nw)=O(V). This conclusion does not need
r to dominate a separately incurred DK cost per record. It includes
initialization, parameter acquisition, source reads, all returns, staging,
copying, erasure and repeat-loop work.

## 7. Retained historical backing and repeated calls

Offsets below are relative to each role's current origin. Every private
role visits its owned guard at -1 and at most the following nonnegative
extent, inclusive of the blank at the indicated endpoint.

| Role | Maximum nonnegative offset |
| --- | --- |
| OUTPUT, DTRACE | V each |
| HTRACE | E |
| LENGTH | maximum Gamma prefix length, at most E |
| DOUBLE | max of the nine decoded parameters |
| Each of nine unary parameter roles | its own decoded value |
| MASK, COUNT | DK each |
| REAL, IMAG | w each |

There are exactly eighteen private roles: the table counts the nine
parameter roles separately, and no coefficient or address creates another
physical role. Every listed extent remains charged after erasure. If K0
is their total initial physical history, union with the above visited
intervals gives an upper bound by K0 plus the sum of the eighteen interval
lengths. For L=DK, the latter is at most

\[
3V+2E+2p+2d+6L+4w+36.
\]

To see this, bound DOUBLE's extent by p+d+L+w+(r+P+S). The terms involving
r,P,S, including their own unary roles, total at most 6N<=V. The two
full-payload roles contribute 2V. The remaining terms have the displayed
linear bounds. In particular, the simpler published envelope is

\[
\boxed{K_0+4V+32(E+p+d+DK+w+1).}
\]

Public DATA/HEADER and unrelated exterior reservations are separate paid
caller backing. This bounds retained history, not live nonblank bits.
It applies to arbitrary translated origins and arbitrary entry histories
under the blankness/ownership premise.

Success leaves all newly visited private cells blank. Existing untouched
tails remain as they were. Consequently a bank whose old longer tails were
blank can serve a smaller later call without rescanning historical capacity;
growing and regrowing calls only add newly reached intervals. The same
eighteen tape identities and histories can persist over any finite sequence
of successful calls. Cumulative history is the union of absolute visited
windows per role. At fixed role origins, this is equivalently bounded using
the maximum reached extent of each role; no maximum of total per-call
footprints is substituted. If origins change between calls, retain the
absolute per-role union and separately pay the caller's head transport.
Source acquisition/re-encoding between calls is separately paid caller work.
Failure reuse and stale external-handle authority are unclaimed.

## 8. Join to the literal egress and limits

Initial source disk-grid inputs have component numerators of magnitude at
most 2^p. With w>=p+2, every signed permutation and negation required by S_D
fits. S_D preserves the complex disk exactly, with no numerical rounding.
After a supplied exact C tensor and the existing literal b^D/Q_p egress,
the same disk guarantee holds before the final S_D sweep. Therefore both
uses of the new program succeed on intended admitted layer inputs.

Componentwise toward-zero Q_p commutes with signed real/imaginary
permutations, since trunc_0 is odd. Scalar b^D also commutes with S_D.
Thus a correctly bound exact C producer, followed by the literal egress
and this final sweep, returns exactly Q_p(H0^tensor D z), with only that
one projection. The old header and original address/coefficient order
must survive the supplied C service. Its w-to-common-grid conversion,
recursive children, precision proof, backing and complete cost remain paid
premises. The sweep does not construct that service.

One may reserve distinct private inventories for the phase table (18 roles)
and the egress table (16 roles), sharing the two public tapes. This uses
36 fixed tapes, retains both histories and avoids unproved workspace
aliasing. The phase inventory can be reused for the final sweep after its
successful initial retirement. The known boundary passes have total O(V)
time and added history in the source bands. This is a concrete interface
reduction, not a complete multiplier or a new asymptotic kappa.

All five global assumptions retain their status. This package supplies no
arbitrary mixed-width monomial wrapper, affine routing, tensor C compiler,
source allocation theorem, native all-column admission, packed permutation
or integer recovery. It is not a general quadratic phase provider.

## Open next questions

1. Join an actual completed C consumer to the two literal S sweeps and the
   pinned literal egress, preserving canonical order, original header,
   common-grid width and all physical owners. The remaining C service must
   be executable, not an unpriced mathematical transform.
2. Can shared private inventories reduce the 36-tape constructive wrapper
   without invalidating historical backing or entry blankness? This is
   optional economy, not a prerequisite for the fixed-tape result.
3. Can other source monomial recipes generate their active masks and
   repetition grammar at a comparable literal interface? The linear S_D
   phase here does not settle variable-dimensional quadratic recipes.
